initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a provenance identity fault before Job 2. The upstream provenance handoff uses source IDs as evidence record IDs, so Job 2 receives evidence_sources with record_id values s01..s08 instead of the demand record IDs n06-r01..n06-r08. This violates the requirement to preserve record identities/provenance and causes Job 2 priority rows to have upstream_rank 0 for every need because the downstream lookup is by demand record_id. The visible source localizes this to assemble_provenance, which appends record_id from record.get('source_id') rather than record.get('record_id').
